hypotheses.description: get_func_args_dict in scrapy/utils/python.py calls inspect.signature(func) with default annotation evaluation and only catches ValueError. On Python 3.14, PEP 649 lazy annotations mean annotations such as scrapy.Request in a TYPE_CHECKING-only import are not resolved at function definition time; inspect.signature can then evaluate them and raise NameError. Because get_func_args_dict only needs parameter names/defaults, not resolved annotation values, passing annotation_format=inspect.Format.FORWARDREF (or otherwise deferring annotation evaluation) would avoid the crash. Evidence E1 shows the unguarded inspect.signature call, while E13 and E20 show downstream consumers that would inherit the failure.
